title: Emerging Markets and Liquidity Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Liquidity plumbing and possible emerging-market rotation.
coverage_note: All sections/text and image labels read. Covers reserves/M2, household distribution/revisions, Ulta update, Bitcoin-liquidity correlation, Ark trust/storage, platform regulation, Nostr, and differentiated EM/gold calls. Pure platform news and quoted GDP nowcasts are not attributed as author forecasts.

framework_lessons: Separate currency translation from real growth.
assessment: Concrete M2/RRP direction and 2025 QT timing are supported. The broad rotation remains conditional and uneven, while JD still has an open stated horizon. The article increasingly treats affordability stress as recession, which helps describe distribution but weakens falsifiability. Technical custody explanations need explicit security assumptions; legal motive claims and commissioned liquidity statistics require independent reproduction.
verification_limitations: Current snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date vintage.
Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
